Every raw method header reads 'FULL MS / DD-MS2 (TOPN)', TopN 10; ref [44] (cited for the LC-MS set-up): 'operated in the data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode'.

Model string in each raw header: 28 HF* files 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS', 15 QEP* files 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS'. PRIDE lists both Q Exactive Plus (MS:1002634) and Q Exactive HF (MS:1002523). The paper Methods names only the Q Exactive Plus - contradicted by the raw files (raw > paper).

Model string in each raw header: 28 HF* files 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS', 15 QEP* files 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS'. PRIDE lists both Q Exactive Plus (MS:1002634) and Q Exactive HF (MS:1002523). The paper Methods names only the Q Exactive Plus - contradicted by the raw files (raw > paper).

Paper: histone bands 'chemically acylated ... and in-gel digested with trypsin'. Acylation blocks Lys so trypsin cuts after Arg only ('Arg-C-like', ref44); the digestion enzyme is trypsin (campaign rule 2).

Paper: 'a % relative abundance (%RA) value for the sample (light channel - L) or the internal standard (heavy channel - H)'. EpiProfile ran in 'histone with SILAC' mode and reports LightR/HeavyR with heavy areas near-constant across runs (spike-in), light areas variable. Multiplicity 2 verified (campaign rule 14).

limitations: techsdrf is not installed; instrument, acquisition mode, NCE and MS1 range were read from HTTP-range-read .raw headers only.

No search-engine parameter file is deposited: EpiProfile 2.0 (targeted XIC extraction) parameters, including precursor/fragment tolerances, are not deposited or stated -> tolerances 'not available'. comment[modification parameters] is reconstructed from the paper's chemistry, ref44's EpiProfile/MaxQuant variable-modification list for the same protocols and the Arg10 heavy label of the lab's super-SILAC method (ref44/ref19), not read from a deposited search file.

The heavy label (Arg10, UNIMOD:267) is taken from the lab's published histone super-SILAC method (ref19 'Arg-10' SILAC-DMEM; ref44 'Arg10 was selected as heavy label (multiplicity = 2) in ... EpiProfile 2'), which this paper cites; this paper itself does not name the heavy amino acid, and no MS1 heavy/light mass offset was measured.

The cell lines making up the heavy super-SILAC reference mixes are not named in this paper (refs [42]/[43], not open access). Ref19 (2016) used MDA-MB-231, MDA-MB-468, MDA-MB-453 and MDA-MB-361 for its breast cancer mix, but it is not stated that the mix used here is identical, so the components are not listed.

reconcile reports instrument_contradicted (protocol names only Q Exactive Plus; 28 rows say Q Exactive HF). Refuted: the 28 HF* raw headers read 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS' and PRIDE lists Q Exactive HF; the paper prose is incomplete.
The 22 FFPE runs of this deposit are not annotated (review round 1, coordinator decision): no source keys the FFPE raw files to HPV status or patient; see annotations/BLOCKED.md and the report.

Donor identity and the empty/E6-E7 pairing per donor are not documented by any source (Sample_list.txt gives only the arm; Supplementary Data sheet 3 has no file names). An L/H-ratio match paired replicates #1/#2 convincingly but did not resolve #3 (QEP220614_18 vs HF220822_35 errors 0.1245 vs 0.1221), so characteristics[individual] = not available and biological replicates are numbered 1-3 per arm without implying pairing. The paper's paired t-test design is therefore not recoverable from this SDRF.
Only 3 of the 5 donors' cultures per arm have deposited raw files; replicates #4/#5 (QEP230822_RN_Lavinia_HK_1-4) exist only as EpiProfile outputs in FFPE2308.zip.
Donor age and sex are not mapped to cultures ('male and female donors') -> 'not available'.
The keratinocyte culture medium (Keratinocyte-SFM) has no column under the declared templates (culture medium is a cell-lines column) and is recorded in the report only.
